title: Kathu Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2022 Half Marathon Was Like
seo_title: Kathu Marathon Phuket Review: The 2022 Half Marathon in Numbers
meta_description: Kathu Marathon review from the 2022 Kathu Half Marathon in Phuket: a 5.30am start, 25°C and 94% humidity, 558 half-marathon finishers with a 2:11 median, and how the race has changed since.
dek: What Kathu's municipal race in Phuket was like at its 2022 edition, when the half marathon was the longest distance: the start, the weather, the field and how fast it ran, and what has changed for 2026.
verdict: Enter if you want a friendly, municipal Phuket race with cash prizes for age-group winners and a field that runs at a sensible club pace. In 2022 the half marathon started at 5.30am in 25°C air at 94% humidity, with almost no wind, and 558 runners finished it with a median of 2:11. The race has grown since: a full marathon was added in 2025, and the 2026 edition offers five distances. What runners found in 2022 is the best guide to the half, not to the new marathon.

sections.heading: The 2022 Race: A Half Marathon With Three Shorter Runs
paragraphs: In 2022 the Kathu race, run by Kathu Town Municipality, was a half marathon. Its 25th edition offered a 21 km half, a 10 km mini marathon (timed at 10.5 km), a 6 km fun run and a 2.5 km health walk, and about 3,000 people took part [1][8]. The organisers said it ran on some of the most beautiful roads in Kathu [1], but no route map for 2022 was published.

Local officials describe Kathu as good running country, with slopes as well as long flat stretches through green scenery [3][5]. The 2026 half-marathon map shows one large loop rather than an out-and-back [6]; whether it matches the 2022 route is not known.

sections.heading: The Weather: Still and Saturated
paragraphs: No schedule for 2022 was published, but the timing data puts the half-marathon start at about 5.30am, the 10.5 km at 6am and the 6 km at 6.10am [8], the same times the 2023 race advertised [2]. Phuket airport, about 20 km north of Kathu, recorded 25°C with a 24°C dew point, 94% humidity and a 1-knot breeze at 5.30am, and the air was dead calm by 6am [7]. It cooled to 24°C and 100% humidity at 6.30am and 7am, then warmed to 26°C at 8am; showers were reported nearby at 8.30am and light rain at 9am [7].

With no wind and the air saturated, sweat does little. A two-hour half marathoner finished at about 7.30am, before it warmed; the slowest finishers, at about 3:28, came in around 9am in the first rain.

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: The 2022 half marathon had 558 finishers. It was won in 1:22:34 by a man and 1:42:14 by a woman; tenth place overall was 1:29:45, and tenth woman ran 1:55:45 [8]. The median finisher took 2:11:04 and the slowest tenth more than 2:53. A third of finishers broke two hours and almost three-quarters broke 2:30; 24% were women [8]. The 40 to 49 age group was the largest [8].

The shorter races were bigger: 370 runners finished the 10.5 km and 975 the 6 km [8]. With more than 390 trophies and a B80,000 prize pot spread across age groups in all three timed races [1], plus fancy-dress awards and prizes for the youngest and oldest winners, a steady age-group runner has a fair chance of collecting something.

sections.heading: How the Race Has Changed Since 2022
paragraphs: In 2024 the half was lengthened to 23 km and renamed the Kathu Super Half Marathon [3]. A full 42 km marathon was added for the December 2025 race [4]. The 2026 edition, on Sunday 13 December, offers a 42.195 km marathon, a 21.097 km half, a 10.5 km, a 6 km fun run and a 2.5 km walk, with a cap of 5,000 runners [5][6].

The 2026 cut-offs are 4 hours 30 for the half and 7 hours for the marathon, and only finishers inside them get a finisher shirt [6]; every 2022 half-marathon finisher would have made that half limit [8]. Fees are THB 700 for the marathon and THB 400 for the half, and shirts and bibs are collected at Kathu Municipality on 11 and 12 December, 9am to 6pm [6].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, for the half marathon or shorter, if you want a cheap, community-run Phuket race with a generous limit, plenty of trophies and a field in which half the runners take longer than 2:11.
Think twice before choosing the marathon on this evidence alone: it is only in its second year, and no account of its course or support has been published.
Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on local press reports, the 2026 entry page, the full 2022 results and airport weather records.

faqs.question: How fast is the Kathu half marathon field?
faqs.answer: Club pace. At the 2022 race, 558 runners finished the half marathon with a median of 2:11:04; a third broke two hours and almost three-quarters broke 2:30. It was won in 1:22:34 by a man and 1:42:14 by a woman, and tenth place overall was 1:29:45.

faqs.question: Does the Kathu Marathon have a full marathon?
faqs.answer: Only since 2025. Until then the race was a half marathon with shorter runs, and in 2022 its longest distance was 21 km. The half was lengthened to 23 km in 2024, and the 13 December 2026 race offers 42.195 km, 21.097 km, 10.5 km, 6 km and a 2.5 km walk.

faqs.question: What is the weather like at the Kathu race in Phuket?
faqs.answer: Warm, saturated and still. At the 5.30am half-marathon start in 2022, Phuket airport recorded 25°C, a 24°C dew point and 94% humidity with almost no wind. Humidity reached 100% by 6.30am, it was 26°C by 8am, and light rain arrived around 9am.

editorial_notes: Written 2026-11-06 about the 2022 edition (25th Kathu Half Marathon, Sunday 11 December 2022), the only edition for which we hold results; the 2023 to 2025 races ran but are not covered. The 2022 race had no full marathon, so this review describes the half only. Finish-time figures are Run SEA's analysis of the official SportStats 21.1 km results; 10.5 km and 6 km finisher counts are from the same results. Start times are derived from the timing data and match the published 2023 schedule. Weather is from Phuket airport METAR, about 20 km north of Kathu. No 2022 route map, cut-off, aid plan or runner account was found; the Phuket Express pre-race article was blocked. The Phuket News numbers the editions inconsistently (2025 and 2026 both called the 29th); the 2026 entry page says 29th. No rating.
